title: On the structure of isolated singularities for semilinear elliptic equations
summary: In this paper, we study isolated singularities of the following semilinear elliptic equation $-Δu+\frac12 x\cdot \nabla u+\frac{1}{q-1}u-u^q=0$ in $Ω\setminus \{0\}$, where $n\ge 3$, $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is a domain, $0 \in Ω$ and $q>1$. This equation arises in the study of blow-up profiles of semilinear heat equations. For $\frac{n}{n-2} \frac{n+2}{n-2}$.
